id: title:Gilbert09:stop duplicate key probe reporting permission denials

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion and duplicate-key probe behavior
review.reason: Adds a psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege exception handler in P1.F1.H1, returning None and logging a debug message instead of propagating the error. This changes the warehouse ingestion behavior: when the connecting role lacks privilege, the duplicate-key probe is skipped rather than failing, preventing false-positive error reports and allowing warehouse sync to continue. This,
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that this permission gap is a common or expected condition rather than a critical failure; the patch does not demonstrate actual adoption or incident avoidance, and the tier is assigned conservatively based on the localized maintenance and behavior correction.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
